reason_zh: 三份已完成的 2026-08-20 Research Object 已转换为完整双语 Editorial Architecture 2.1 候选，并具备已核验的规划工件与确定性基础题图。

candidates.researchQuestion: When the visible action name does not fully determine what will execute, what evidence should a digital employee use before treating an action as authorized?
candidates.title: A Safe Command Name Is Not Execution Authority
candidates.title_zh: 安全的命令名，不等于执行权限
candidates.coreProposition: For digital employees, a nominal action name is evidence of intent, not execution authority; when configuration, wrappers or environment can redirect behavior, admission must bind executable identity, execution context and governing policy, while approval and effect containment remain separate gates.

sections.heading: The label describes intent; the context determines behavior
sections.heading_zh: 标签描述意图，上下文决定行为

sections.heading: Failing closed does not mean asking about everything
sections.heading_zh: Fail-closed 不等于凡事都询问

sections.heading: Bind the authorization record to effective execution
sections.heading_zh: 把授权记录绑定到实际执行

sections.heading: Approval is not containment
sections.heading_zh: Approval 仍然不是 Effect Containment

evidenceClaims.claim: The merged Codex change removes Git from Unix and Windows known-safe command classification because repository configuration can redirect nominally read-only operations into helper execution.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 已合并的 Codex 变更把 Git 从 Unix 与 Windows 的 Known-safe Command Classification 中移除，因为仓库配置可以把名义只读操作重定向到 Helper Execution。

evidenceClaims.claim: Under UnlessTrusted, plain git status reaches approval unless an explicit execution-policy rule authorizes it.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 在 UnlessTrusted 下，普通 git status 会进入 Approval，除非显式 Execution-policy Rule 已授权。

evidenceClaims.claim: Absolute-path tests distinguish a policy-covered host executable from another unmatched Git path.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: Absolute-path 测试区分由 Policy 覆盖的 Host Executable 与另一条未匹配 Git Path。

evidenceClaims.claim: An end-to-end regression reaches human approval and preserves denial as the command result.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 端到端回归进入 Human Approval，并把 Denial 保留为命令结果。

evidenceClaims.claim: Authorization should bind to effective execution identity and context rather than only a nominal action label.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 授权应绑定 Effective Execution Identity 与 Context，而不能只绑定 Nominal Action Label。

evidenceClaims.claim: Intent, execution identity, policy authority and effect containment should remain separate audit facts.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: Intent、Execution Identity、Policy Authority 与 Effect Containment 应保持为不同 Audit Fact。

projectRelevance.rationale: The conclusion concerns general execution governance for digital employees and agent runtimes.

communityEdition.rationale: The complete Research Center edition already addresses the transferable engineering question; a separate community edition would not add enough distinct value.

candidates.researchQuestion: Should cross-agent history be replayed as stored, or reconstructed as a policy-governed projection of mixed-trust local state?
candidates.title: History Is Not a Transfer Contract
candidates.title_zh: 历史记录不是跨 Agent 传输契约
candidates.coreProposition: Cross-agent history should be a destination-specific, policy-enforcing projection of mixed-trust local state: remove unauthorized control material while its semantic structure is still available, preserve legitimate local evidence separately, and do not mistake selective projection for general confidentiality or peer trust.

sections.heading: Retention authority and disclosure authority are different
sections.heading_zh: Retention Authority 与 Disclosure Authority 不是一回事

sections.heading: Representation order is a security boundary
sections.heading_zh: Representation Order 本身就是安全边界

sections.heading: A destination projection creates two useful views
sections.heading_zh: Destination Projection 产生两个有用视图

sections.heading: Scrubbing one path is not A2A confidentiality
sections.heading_zh: 一条路径完成 Scrub，不等于 A2A Confidentiality

evidenceClaims.claim: RemoteA2aAgent reconstructs outbound messages from local session history, and the merged fix removes credential-bearing request calls from that path.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: RemoteA2aAgent 从 Local Session History 重建 Outbound Message；已合并修复从该路径移除携带凭据的 Request Call。

evidenceClaims.claim: The scrub runs before rendering can inline structured function-call arguments into text.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: Scrub 在 Rendering 把 Structured Function-call Argument 内联为文本之前执行。

evidenceClaims.claim: The detector combines known credential-call names with nested AuthConfig shape while preserving ordinary siblings.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: Detector 结合已知 Credential-call Name 与 Nested AuthConfig Shape，并保留普通 Sibling。

evidenceClaims.claim: Filtering operates on a deep-copied outbound representation and leaves the original local event intact.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 过滤作用于 Deep-copied Outbound Representation，并保持原始 Local Event 完整。

evidenceClaims.claim: Session history should be treated as mixed-trust evidence rather than universally transferable conversation state.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: Session History 应被视为 Mixed-trust Evidence，而不是可无条件传输的 Conversation State。

evidenceClaims.claim: Cross-agent context should be projected while security-relevant semantic structure is still available.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: Cross-agent Context 应在 Security-relevant Semantic Structure 仍存在时完成 Projection。

projectRelevance.rationale: The conclusion concerns general cross-agent context and trust-boundary architecture.

communityEdition.rationale: The complete Research Center edition already addresses the transferable architecture question; a separate community edition would not add enough distinct value.

candidates.researchQuestion: What should an artifact version mean operationally when visibility, writer ownership and durable storage are separate state transitions?
candidates.title: Visible Is Not Durable
candidates.coreProposition: Artifact publication should model reservation, staged completeness, reader visibility and durable persistence as separate lifecycle facts: pending isolation plus atomic rename can establish process-level visibility under stated filesystem assumptions, but rename success is not crash-durability evidence and abandoned-state recovery needs independent ownership proof.

sections.heading: Incomplete state should not inhabit the reader namespace
sections.heading_zh: Incomplete State 不应进入 Reader Namespace

sections.heading: Ownership and publication need different synchronization points
sections.heading_zh: Ownership 与 Publication 需要不同同步点

sections.heading: Rename establishes visibility—not persistence
sections.heading_zh: Rename 建立 Visibility，不建立 Persistence

evidenceClaims.claim: The merged FileArtifactService reserves versions in hidden pending directories ignored by normal integer-version discovery.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 已合并 FileArtifactService 在普通 Integer-version Discovery 忽略的隐藏 Pending Directory 中预留 Version。

evidenceClaims.claim: Payload and metadata are staged before one os.replace exposes the complete tree under the integer version name.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: Payload 与 Metadata 先完成 Staging，再通过一次 os.replace 把完整 Tree 以 Integer Version Name 暴露。

evidenceClaims.claim: Directory creation arbitrates concurrent reservations and a destination recheck prevents stale-list overwrite.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: Directory Creation 仲裁并发 Reservation，Destination Recheck 防止 Stale-list Overwrite。

evidenceClaims.claim: The maintainers explicitly exclude full power-loss durability because files and parent directories are not fsync-synchronized.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 维护者明确排除完整 Power-loss Durability，因为 File 与 Parent Directory 没有通过 fsync 同步。

evidenceClaims.claim: Abandoned pending reservations may leave permanent gaps when another writer's ownership cannot safely be declared stale.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 当另一个 Writer 的 Ownership 无法被安全判定为 Stale 时，Abandoned Pending Reservation 可以留下永久 Gap。

evidenceClaims.claim: Reservation, staged completeness, reader visibility and durable persistence should be separate artifact lifecycle facts.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: Reservation、Staged Completeness、Reader Visibility 与 Durable Persistence 应成为不同 Artifact Lifecycle Fact。

projectRelevance.rationale: The conclusion concerns a general artifact-publication, storage and recovery lifecycle.

communityEdition.rationale: The complete Research Center edition already addresses the transferable engineering question; a separate community edition would not add enough distinct value.
